**Company Overview:**
Matter, accessible via getmatter.app, is a startup focused on enhancing the reading experience for its users through a mobile application. The company operates in the digital content and mobile app market, targeting avid readers and individuals who seek personalized and curated reading material.
Matter's primary clients are tech-savvy consumers who value high-quality, customized content delivered directly to their mobile devices.
**Business Model:**
Matter employs a freemium business model. This means that the basic version of the app is free to use, but users can opt for premium features through a subscription service.
Matter places a strong emphasis on user privacy and data security. The company collects personal information based on user interactions with the app and ensures that all data is handled with the utmost care.

excerpts:
Prividium Technology Careers

The company behind Prividium®
Matter Labs builds Prividium
The Ethereum-secured blockchain platform for banks and financial institutions.
Talk to our team Explore the platform
What is Matter Labs
Matter Labs is the engineering company behind Prividium® , the blockchain platform that lets banks and financial institutions issue, settle, and manage digital assets with privacy, compliance, and full control of their data.
What does Matter Labs do?
Matter Labs is the engineering company that builds Prividium, the Ethereum-secured blockchain platform for banks and financial institutions. Prividium runs as a private, permissioned chain in the institution's own infrastructure, with every transaction anchored to Ethereum.
Matter Labs also builds ZKsync, the public zero-knowledge network based on the same technology.
What is Prividium?
Prividium is Matter Labs' enterprise blockchain platform: a private, permissioned blockchain you run in your own infrastructure, with every transaction anchored to Ethereum for finality.
Matter Labs is the company. Prividium is its enterprise platform for financial institutions, and ZKsync is the public zero-knowledge network it also builds. When you read about Prividium deployments or ZKsync technology, that's Matter Labs' work.
How do we get started with Prividium?
Talk to the Matter Labs team for a platform walkthrough and an architecture review for your use case. Technical documentation is public at docs.zksync.io, so your engineers can evaluate the stack directly.
